reviews.text: I've finally managed to stop them from turning my Bichon Frise into a Poodle. He's the best dog groomer ever. I can assure you I've been to quite a few. I highly recommend him to anyone who owns this breed.

I went with my dog ​​for the first time, and honestly, I don't plan on going back.
The moment I walked in, the owner told me off because I hadn't specified my dog's breed when making the appointment. I understand that this information might be required, but in my case, I didn't see it requested during the booking process. The problem wasn't that he told me, but how he said it. I think there are much more polite and courteous ways to treat a customer, especially when it's their first time at the establishment.
The haircut was finished ahead of schedule, so I have no complaints about that.
What finally made me decide not to return was the way another woman who works there, and who, as far as I could tell, also handles product sales, treated me. The moment she saw my dog's harness, she made disparaging comments about it, saying it was very ugly, and immediately tried to sell me another one for over €100. When I told her I wasn't going to spend that much money on a harness, she insisted I at least buy the leash, which was also very expensive. I felt like I was being subjected to some pretty aggressive sales tactics.

Furthermore, they scheduled an appointment for the following month, even though I usually take my dog ​​every three months because I like her hair to be longer. I felt like they were trying to impose a schedule that didn't suit my needs.
In short, my dissatisfaction isn't with the work done on my dog, but with the way I was treated and the pressure to sell products and schedule more appointments. For me, courtesy and respect are just as important as the service itself, so I canceled the next appointment and won't be going back.

Very kind and careful with my dog.
I'll be back!
Spectacular!!! Very professional! Incredible service! We'll be back soon! Thank you, Yulia! My dog's before and after!

They cut my dogs belly open back in 2023 and didn't say anything about it. We found blood all over the floor and had to get him stitches. When we told the owner he said he didn't groom him someone else at the shop did. No accountability for his staff at all and no real apology. It was horrific. We said he had to pay for the vet bill which he did at least. My poor dog was afraid to go to the groomer for at least a year after. We've found a much better groomer now who the dogs love.

My dog ​​has short hair (a dachshund), and I can't use their services except for nail trimming. The owner perfectly blends gentleness with a sense of normalcy regarding the "drama."

Fast, attentive, and readily available. I wouldn't consider going anywhere else.

I've never seen you win a medal 🏅 at an Artero exhibition. You didn't even qualify. All your other in-person exhibitions were at competitions and exhibitions at the fourth regional level. Greetings from an older student, whom you wouldn't even let touch a machine or scissors. …
This is the first time I've taken my poodle and I've left delighted; the experience shows in the good result.
Excellent service. Professional staff. Thank you, Katerina!
Wonderful specialist Kateryna :)
We took our dog to Katya. We were very satisfied. And they cut his hair very nicely. And our Finn was satisfied.
Fantastic, unbeatable service!

She's a very unpleasant and rude person. The first thing I asked was if they put the dogs in cages, and the answer was yes, and I wasn't even interested in the price anymore. She got defensive and told me to take her to a Zen groomer. She didn't understand that I didn't want to. My dog ​​is 14 years old and scared enough to go to a place like that and be put in a cage until I pick her up. I explained that the groomer I used to take her to, which has since closed, didn't have cages because, of course, they don't take in a thousand dogs a day, and this one had several when I went. In short, there's no way I'm leaving my dog ​​there. I found another one, and it's great!! Oh, it's a Zen groomer 🤭

We went for the first time a few months ago when Coco, our miniature schnauzer, was quite old. We decided to try their haircut because it was close to our house, and we really wish we'd gone sooner. She looked beautiful and left feeling happy, with less anxiety than at other salons we'd taken her to. The last time we were able to take her, she was very sick, and she was treated with such gentleness that it touched me deeply. They did the best job they could, prioritizing our dog's well-being, and she still looked great.

They crossbreed dogs that are direct relatives and, as a result, your pet has a very short life (it didn't reach 6 years) and suffered a lot every day from heart disease and kidney problems, among others.
They took care of my Spanish Water Dog from one day to the next. They bathed her and she looks fantastic! Thank you so much!
I'm absolutely delighted with Luis and his team. He gave my poodle her first haircut and she looked gorgeous! He'll definitely be her groomer forever.
I took my poodle there for the first time yesterday, the service was fabulous and Luis made her look beautiful, we will definitely be back, my little one now has her groomer.
This is the second time I've taken my little ones (Shih Tzus) to the groomer, and I'm delighted with the service and how gorgeous they look when they leave. I'll definitely keep taking them there.

This hair salon and academy is fantastic. Thanks to the Sircan family, I've been able to train there and become a great professional. I wholeheartedly recommend it to any future students who want to learn. You'll leave fully prepared to give it your all and showcase your talent.
I take my giant white poodle to Jorge every month and I'm so happy. They know how to treat these dogs.
Excellent professional

Had to buy dog food that the big stores around didn't have in stock that day. I payed more than double the price that it costs in other stores and at home I realized the dog food I bought was already expired. Feeling scammed.
